take: Per the team's announcement, Philadelphia activated defenseman Helge Grans from the Injured Non-Roster list and placed Rasmus Ristolainen on injured reserve. Ristolainen was a second-pair defenseman playing 18:17 a night and killing penalties. In the five games since he went out, Oliver Bonk has moved in beside Travis Sanheim, Nick Seeler is up to 21:58 a night from 17:35, and Sanheim is up to 26:32 from 24:22. Those two carry the load. Grans has one game this season, 12:43 of ice time.
